scope: Exercise an optional half-phrase data replacement helper on the real frozen candidate source pack with an artificial original128 batch. No model training or source scoring.
replacement_slots: 0..15 positive and32..55 negative; other40 core phrase and48 ambient inputs remain exact. Original y and weights untouched.
sampling: For positive choose target hey_nyx; for negative uniform hey_nick/hey_next/hey_mix. Then uniform five engines, voice-token family, unique canonical WAV hash, original variant0/1/2. Voice family is sorted union of all original alias speaker tokens within engine. Preserve all source metadata; aliases do not add a new draw. Nexus/Hi ESP remain in the pack but are excluded from this arm.
limits: This optional helper and input-contract probe do not register or launch v40, establish model benefit, or replace current source/feature data.
Actual baseline128/FullSourceBatch80 RNG preservation must be checked in GPU integration; this Mac probe uses an artificial baseline and never claims real v37 draws were replayed.
Original source labels are intended text, not newly reviewed pronunciation. Blends, conditions, aliases and renders are correlated.
No learned checkpoint, model scores, optimizer, validation/new/final data, audio playback/recording, firmware or device access.
